entry.title: H Blackstone εξαγοράζει τη Skroutz από τη CVC – Στα 635 εκατ. ευρώ η αποτίμηση
entry.summary: Blackstone is acquiring a majority stake in Greek e-commerce platform Skroutz from CVC Capital Partners at a €635m enterprise value, with the deal closing in H2 2026. Founders retain stakes and CEO Giorgos Hatzigeorgiou stays on. Skroutz lists 12m products from 9,000 merchants and serves 2.5m active users across Greece, Cyprus, Romania and Bulgaria.

entry.title: Χανταϊός: Ολοκληρώνεται η εκκένωση του «MV Hondius» – Εντοπίστηκαν νέα κρούσματα
entry.summary: Evacuation of passengers from the 'MV Hondius' cruise ship is being completed today via flights from Australia and the Netherlands. New hantavirus cases identified: a French passenger is positive with deteriorating condition; one American is positive but asymptomatic and another shows mild symptoms. Eight people who left the ship have fallen ill.

entry.title: Η ατζέντα Τραμπ στην Κίνα: Εμπόριο, Ταϊβάν και πίεση προς Σι για Ιράν
entry.summary: Donald Trump travels to Beijing this week for his first China trip since returning to the White House. The agenda spans trade, Taiwan, AI, rare earths and pressuring Xi Jinping on Iran. Despite the high symbolism, including a visit to the Temple of Heaven, the central goal is de-escalating trade tensions.

entry.title: Γεραπετρίτης για drone στη Λευκάδα: Η Μεσόγειος δεν θα γίνει θέατρο πολεμικών επιχειρήσεων – Θα προβούμε σε διαβήματα
entry.summary: Greek FM George Gerapetritis will brief today's EU Foreign Affairs Council on the naval drone discovered off Lefkada, calling it a particularly serious development. Athens plans to lodge diplomatic protests once the Hellenic General Staff investigation concludes. The minister stressed that Greece will not allow the Mediterranean to become a theatre of military operations.

entry.title: Τουρκία: Ξεκινά η δίκη του Εκρέμ Ιμάμογλου για «πολιτική κατασκοπεία»
entry.summary: The trial of dismissed Istanbul mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, his adviser Necati Özkan and journalist Merdan Yanardağ on 'political espionage' charges has begun at Marmara prison in Silivri. The 160-page indictment seeks 15-20 years in prison plus a political ban on İmamoğlu, covering activities from 2019 to 2025.

entry.title: Ιράν: Οι προτάσεις προς τις ΗΠΑ ήταν «γενναιόδωρες και υπεύθυνες»
entry.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baqaei calls Tehran's proposals to Washington 'generous and responsible' and accuses the US of 'unreasonable demands'. President Trump publicly rejected Iran's response via Truth Social, calling it 'totally unacceptable'.

entry.title: Νετανιάχου στο CBS: Στόχος του Ισραήλ η απεξάρτηση από την αμερικανική στρατιωτική βοήθεια
entry.summary: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu told CBS '60 Minutes' Israel aims to wean itself off US military aid within a decade. Israel receives roughly $3.8bn per year; Netanyahu wants to begin the review 'now' rather than wait for the next Congress, citing deepening ties with Gulf states.

entry.title: Αδήλωτα POS, αόρατες συναλλαγές
entry.summary: Greece's AADE tax authority is targeting a new wave of tax evasion via undeclared point-of-sale terminals, mostly foreign-issued, which print receipts that never reach the e-tax systems. Despite the €2.5bn collected through linking cash registers to POS, businesses are routing transactions to evade detection.

entry.title: Ο ελέφαντας του αμερικανικού χρέους
entry.summary: Alexis Papachelas examines the 'elephant in the room' of America's debt — now above 100% of GDP and rising. For the first time, debt servicing exceeds annual defence spending, worsened by $25bn already spent on the Iran war and Trump's commitments to new defence programmes. The trajectory threatens the dollar's global status.

entry.title: Ε.Ε.: Κυρώσεις για εποίκους στη Δυτική Οχθη – Πρώτα σενάρια διαλόγου με τη Ρωσία στο Συμβούλιο ΥΠΕΞ
entry.summary: EU foreign ministers will today try to seal political agreement on sanctions against violent Israeli settlers in the West Bank. The package, targeting seven individuals and entities, had been blocked since December 2024 by Hungary's veto until the recent change of government in Budapest under Péter Magyar. Talks may also explore opening dialogue with Moscow.

entry.title: Γαλλία και Βρετανία θα φιλοξενήσουν αύριο συνάντηση για τα Στενά του Ορμούζ
entry.summary: Britain and France will co-chair tomorrow a meeting of defence ministers from 40+ countries to discuss military plans for restoring trade flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi warned against the deployment of warships. The UK has dispatched HMS Dragon to the Middle East.

entry.title: Χανταϊός: Χωρίς συμπτώματα ο Ελληνας επιβάτης του «Hondius – Η ανακοίνωση του «Αττικόν»
entry.summary: The Greek 'MV Hondius' passenger remains symptom-free with no signs of active hantavirus infection while in a precautionary 45-day quarantine at Attikon Hospital. The hospital director stresses isolation is purely for surveillance and prevention, with no confirmed infection.

entry.title: Αδ. Γεωργιάδης: Κανένας απολύτως φόβος εξάπλωσης του χανταϊού στην Ελλάδα
entry.summary: Health Minister Adonis Georgiadis insists there is 'absolutely no danger' of hantavirus spread in Greece after the Greek 'MV Hondius' passenger was repatriated. The passenger has been placed in a negative-pressure isolation room at Attikon Hospital for a precautionary 45-day quarantine. Georgiadis criticised as 'toxic' the conspiracy-minded reactions to the repatriation.

entry.title: CNN: Τι μαθαίνει η Κίνα από τον πόλεμο των ΗΠΑ στο Ιράν
entry.summary: CNN examines what China is learning from the three-month US-Iran war. Experts warn Beijing risks overestimating its own capabilities, underestimating its lack of combat experience and adopting a narrow lens on potential Taiwan-related conflict with Washington. The Iran war offers Chinese strategists a live snapshot of American forces in real combat.

entry.title: Χανταϊός: Αλλοι τρεις επιβάτες του κρουαζιερόπλοιου θετικοί
entry.summary: Three more 'MV Hondius' passengers tested positive for the Andes strain of hantavirus. Of 17 evacuated Americans, one is positive but asymptomatic and another has mild symptoms. A French passenger's condition is deteriorating. The ship has docked in the Canary Islands and passengers are being repatriated by military and government aircraft.

entry.title: «Θα σας σκοτώσω όλους»: Πώς συνέβη το επεισόδιο με τους πυροβολισμούς στην Καλλιθέα
entry.summary: Police arrested a 58-year-old man who, while intoxicated, opened fire with an 'Uzi' submachine gun inside a Kallithea nightclub. A 43-year-old female employee was shot in the neck, shoulder blade and jaw and is hospitalised in stable condition at Evangelismos. The attacker had shouted 'I'll kill you all' before opening fire, and was arrested in a rapid police operation.

entry.title: Κρήτη: Παρέσυρε την σύζυγό του με το αυτοκίνητο μπροστά στα παιδιά τους
entry.summary: A domestic-violence incident took place in Pantanassa, Heraklion, where a 30-year-old husband allegedly drove his car at his wife while three of their four children were in the vehicle. She is hospitalised at PAGNI with head injuries. He was arrested after the case turned against him during the initial investigation.

entry.title: Μάχη μεταξύ τους και με το παρελθόν τους
entry.summary: Political scientist Gerasimos Moschonas analyses the fierce contest between PASOK and Alexis Tsipras's emerging new party for second place. He argues the Tsipras vehicle owes its existence to SYRIZA's collapse and the New Left's failure to consolidate, and that its rise or fall will reshape Greece's centre-left landscape either way.

entry.title: Η συνέντευξη Δημητριάδη και οι αντιδράσεις της αντιπολίτευσης
entry.summary: Former Maximos Mansion general secretary Grigoris Dimitriadis told 'Real' that he assumed political responsibility for the wiretaps scandal 'to protect the government and the secret services'. He attacked PASOK's Androulakis and ex-PM Tsipras as drivers of 'toxicity' and ruled out running for office.

entry.title: Τα 25 πρόσωπα στη «βιτρίνα» του κόμματος Τσίπρα
entry.summary: Kathimerini lists the 25 figures set to form the public face of Alexis Tsipras's new party — professionals, scientists and academics who will run as candidates, serve as spokespeople or advise behind the scenes — as the former PM finalises preparations ahead of a June launch.
